summary.text: Jim Guzofski is a Republican state representative from Rockingham 1 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A chaplain and pastor, he took office in the House in December 2024.

paragraphs.text: James Guzofski received a theology degree from Baptist Bible College East.

As of August 2023, he was a Northwood selectman and a chaplain for the Northwood Fire Department, had been in the ministry for 34 years, and had served as pastor of Destiny Christian Church for 14 years.
He took office in the New Hampshire House on December 4, 2024.
